memories.title: GH Milestone as Shared State
memories.context: Need coordination between lead and worker agents across sessions without local file contention.
memories.decision: Use GitHub milestone + issue comments as the shared state layer. No local context files. The milestone IS the state.
consequences: State is visible in GitHub UI
No context files to sync between sessions
alternatives_considered: Local context files (PM pattern) — rejected for write contention risk

memories.title: Lead + Layer-Aligned Workers
memories.context: Needed a team structure for parallel bug fixing that respects repo boundaries.
memories.decision: Lead coordinator triages and reviews. Workers are aligned to layers (web/api/toolkit). Workers implement, lead reviews before Kirk tests.
consequences: Lead catches quality issues before Kirk sees PRs
Workers stay in their lane — boundary rule enforced by role
Cross-layer bugs become new issues, not scope creep
Toolkit fixer may not be needed every session
alternatives_considered: Layer-aligned only (no lead) — rejected, loses review step that has been catching real bugs
Bug-scoped agents (one agent per bug, cross-layer) — rejected, violates boundary model

memories.title: Moderate Autonomy for Issue Filing
memories.context: Workers discover bugs while fixing other bugs. Need a threshold for what they can file vs. what needs Kirk's approval.
memories.decision: Workers can file `bug` issues autonomously (prefixed with [discovered]). Feature/gap items get flagged to Kirk via issue comments. Lead can add `gap` label to existing issues but cannot create new feature/gap issues.
consequences: Bug pipeline stays fed without blocking workers
Design decisions stay with Kirk (creative director role)
Discovery bugs are easy to spot on the board
alternatives_considered: Conservative (all notes local, Kirk reviews) — rejected, too slow
Liberal (agents file anything) — rejected, scope creep risk

memories.name: Design
memories.summary: Design spec complete. Brainstormed team structure, workflow, issue lifecycle. Two-pass spec review, all issues resolved.

memories.name: Setup
memories.summary: Infrastructure complete. GH milestone created in all 4 repos, workflow labels (blocked/parked/gap) created, 4 role prompts written, 6 QA bugs filed on milestone and project board.
